workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Their common free 30-minute slots next week are:
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them (or suggest other slots where all four are free).

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. None of the slots you proposed work for both Elena and David - they're all busy during those times. However, I've identified the following slots where Elena Soto and David Okafor are BOTH free:

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00 or 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see which of these slots work for them? We need a 30-minute slot within any of these windows where all four are free.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I checked all your proposed slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately none of them work for both Priya and Marcus:

- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya is busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00: Priya is busy (Board prep 09:00-09:30, Partner lunch 09:30-10:00)
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Priya is busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00)
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya is busy (marked as "Busy" 09:30-10:00)
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Marcus is busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00, Board prep 15:00-15:30)
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Priya is busy (Hiring panel 15:00-15:30, Contract review 15:30-16:00)

The Priya+Marcus common free slots (Mon 09:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00) don't overlap with any of your Elena+David slots.

It appears there is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are free. We should report this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After thoroughly cross-referencing all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute window next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00-17:00) when Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor are all simultaneously free. The five common free slots for Priya and Marcus (Mon 9:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00) each conflict with scheduled meetings for either Elena Soto or David Okafor. No other overlapping availability exists across all four calendars.
